proposed_decisions: Bib keys Shannon1948MathematicalTheory (intakes of w02b-p15-040 and w02b-p15-041) and ShannonMTC1948Reprint (w02b-p15-042) denote the same held 55-page corrected reprint; keep one record and rewrite the other key.
Glyph R is scoped to sec:p15-w02b-p15-041 (rate of transmission, finite and density forms); other R uses in P15 are unrelated.
H(x), H_x(y) etc. follow Shannon's label notation, shared with w02b-p15-040 and w02b-p15-042 for the same functionals; no conflict in meaning.
T, j and |J(x/y)| in thm:p15-w02b-p15-041-coordinates are the symbols of def:p15-w02b-p15-042-coordinate-change; one registry row with both scopes is enough.

Continuous Section 20 material formerly in this file was removed in favour of w02b-p15-042 (166.3); labels def:p15-w02b-p15-041-density and thm:p15-w02b-p15-041-coordinates are retained (referenced by w02b-p15-040).
